description: This is a test source file containing integration tests for board-related functionalities in the focalboard server, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, duplication, and membership management of boards.

methods.name: TestGetBoards
methods.description: Tests retrieving boards, including filtering by user membership and team.

methods.name: TestCreateBoard
methods.description: Tests creating public and private boards, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: TestCreateBoardTemplate
methods.description: Tests creating board templates (public and private) and access permissions.

methods.name: TestGetAllBlocksForBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieving all blocks for a board, including nested block structures.

methods.name: TestSearchBoards
methods.description: Tests searching for boards with various search terms and permissions.

methods.name: TestGetBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific board with permission and sharing token considerations.

methods.name: TestGetBoardMetadata
methods.description: Tests retrieving metadata for a board, including updates after block modifications and deletion.

methods.name: TestPatchBoard
methods.description: Tests updating board properties with permission validation.

methods.name: TestDeleteBoard
methods.description: Tests deleting a board with permission validation.

methods.name: TestUndeleteBoard
methods.description: Tests undeleting a previously deleted board with permission validation.

methods.name: TestGetMembersForBoard
methods.description: Tests retrieving members of a board, including permission validation.

methods.name: TestAddMember
methods.description: Tests adding members to a board, including permission and role assignment.

methods.name: TestUpdateMember
methods.description: Tests updating board member roles, ensuring at least one admin remains and permission validation.

methods.name: TestDeleteMember
methods.description: Tests removing members from a board with permission validation.

methods.name: TestGetTemplates
methods.description: Tests retrieving built-in templates and duplicating them.

methods.name: TestDuplicateBoard
methods.description: Tests duplicating boards, including from categories, and verifying member roles.

methods.name: TestJoinBoard
methods.description: Tests joining public boards with role assignment based on MinimumRole.
